title: Installing Solar-powered Fans at Bus Stops to Improve Commuter Comfort
what_it_is: Installing Solar-powered Fans at Bus Stops to Improve Commuter Comfort

sections.label: Solar fans at bus stops
sections.summary: LTA has no plans to install solar-powered fans at bus stops, citing limited impact, unfavourable feedback and shading, and will study other options including green roofs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Based on earlier trials conducted by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), fans have a limited impact on the ambient temperature in an exposed bus stop environment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Commuter feedback from the trials was also unfavourable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Most bus stops are also shaded by surrounding buildings and trees, reducing the effectiveness of solar installations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We therefore have no plans to install solar-powered fans at bus stops.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA will continue to study other options to improve commuter comfort at bus stops, including the use of green roofs which can help lower the ambient temperature.

sections.label: Green roof bus stop deployment
sections.summary: Green roof deployment requires reinforced roofs and maintenance access, so it is normally done during scheduled bus stop refurbishment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The question about the green roof deployment, it is not just about putting turf or soil on the bus stop roof and planting some seeds because the structure of the roof must be reinforced to handle the additional weight as well as needs for access for maintenance and things like that.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, we will normally do it during the scheduled refurbishment of bus stops.

sections.label: Greening all new bus stops
sections.summary: A Member asks the Minister of State to confirm whether all new bus stops will be green roofed, saying greening may not be practical across all bus stops.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: Can I seek the Minister of State's confirmation whether there is actually a plan to green roof all the new bus stops from now on?

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: I would say that the greening of bus stop roofs may not be something that is practical across all bus stops.
